name: 86 Chaos 16.0.27 Login Workspace QA Cleanup Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.27 Login Workspace QA Cleanup Fix
notes: Filters deleted and Full Audit QA workspaces from the login-time Choose Workspace screen, not just the in-app switcher.
Skips stale workspace memberships whose restaurant document has already been hard-deleted so users land directly in their remaining real workspace.
Keeps the protected workspace-memberships and login-bootstrap API responses from returning Full Audit QA workspace leftovers.
Preserves Firebase credentials, config, rules, data structures, permissions, and the compact professional UI refinement.
releaseNotes: The pre-app login workspace picker now uses the same strict filtering as the in-app switcher.
Full Audit QA restaurants are hidden by exact QA name/source markers even when stale membership maps still contain old labels.
Missing restaurant documents from stale membership records are no longer shown as selectable workspaces.
No Firebase credentials, rules, project IDs, environment values, or restaurant workflows were changed.
